# Fervent Digital Marketing

> Independent creative studio in Hartbeespoort, South Africa, founded in 2018 by Minette Hartman: creative director with more than 20 years in design for marketing and customer communications. Brand identity and brand books, websites, HTML email, MMS, statement and invoice design, and personalised video. Available for project work, monthly retainers and remote contract roles.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.ferventdigital.co.za/): services, featured projects, experience and ways to work together
- [Portfolio](https://www.ferventdigital.co.za/portfolio.html): case studies in personalised video, HTML email, MMS billing, invoices, onboarding and brand identity
- [CV](https://www.ferventdigital.co.za/cv.html): Minette Hartman's full CV (PDF: https://www.ferventdigital.co.za/assets/Minette-Hartman-CV.pdf)
